title: Original ABProps cache readiness, live Map/record views and resets
oracle: Source-pinned original cache Map mutations and readiness resolver. Ordered synthetic bulk insert/replacement, nontransactional partial failures, empty loads retaining prior records, numeric/string key distinction, null/false/zero presence, local override selection, clear/reinitialize and resolved waits. Source-established config web_image_max_edge is code3042 and default1600 at both selected revisions. No cache or peek resolver is replaced. Source-exported live Map is retained only through actual has/get/delete/clear or strict identity projections. Original partial failed bulk writes are visible through the Map before readiness; successful empty retry admits them to peek. Native delete/clear change values without resetting readiness, while actual cache clear resets readiness and preserves the Map object. Actual Map.get record objects are retained; fresh record arrays share strict record identity and replacements detach old records which actual bulk can later restore by reference. No Map.set or opaque Map snapshot supplies assertions.
